description:
**About Neno**

Neno is defining the next era of AI-native financial services. We merge best-in-class financial technology; banking, payments, invoicing, accounting, payroll and tax with our own expert advisory services team.

Our team is made up of ambitious, unapologetically curious, slightly crazy ex-founders, fintech operators, AI engineers, creatives and corporate finance experts from the Big 4, from all over the world. If you thrive in a high-commitment, high-reward culture and want the autonomy to deliver your best work, this will be the most exciting team you ever join.

Neno is backed by Firstminute Capital, Motive Partners and angels from Miro, Coinbase, Mollie, Juni, Deel, Hugging Face & PayPal.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Founding Product Lead to join Neno's leadership team and own the product vision, strategy and execution that will define how we serve the global mid-market segment for the next decade. This is one of the most consequential hires Neno will make: the person in this role will determine what we build, in what order, for whom, and how those decisions compound into a product that is genuinely irreplaceable for the businesses that rely on it.

You will report directly to the CEO, alongside the VP Engineering and VP Accounting as one of four functional leaders driving Neno's growth. Your remit spans the full product surface: AI-powered accounting workflows, embedded banking and payments infrastructure, invoicing, payroll, tax compliance, and the advisory layer above it all. You will own the roadmap across our beachhead market (The Netherlands) with future expansion into the UK, US & beyond.

Neno's product thesis is specific and ambitious: The global SME market is trapped between inadequate DIY accounting software and expensive traditional accounting firms and deserves a fundamentally better product and service, a system that gets smarter with every transaction, automates the routine and amplifies the expert. Your job is to make that thesis real in every sprint, every feature decision and every interaction a customer has with the product.

The right person is analytically rigorous, deeply curious about AI and financial services, and experienced enough to make hard prioritization calls without needing consensus from everyone in the room. You are as comfortable in a customer discovery interview as you are in an architecture review or a future board strategy session. And you understand that at our stage, shipping the right thing quickly matters more than shipping a perfect thing slowly.

**What Impact You Will Have**

* Own Neno's product vision and roadmap across accounting, banking, payments, invoicing, payroll, tax and the AI layer that powers all of them
* Build and lead the product management function with 2 direct reports (APM and Senior product designer)
* Drive the Agentic AI automation layer of Neno's core workflows, measurably reducing the manual effort our accountants spend per client, quarter over quarter

At FitForMe we help improve the lives of people living with obesity, with science-based supplements and lifelong support after bariatric surgery. We started in the Netherlands, and Dutch clinics know us well. In the UK, clinics have started referring patients to us on their own initiative. Now we need someone to build on both.

As Product Specialist you look after a portfolio of Dutch clinics and grow our relationships with UK clinics remotely. Your customers are surgeons, dietitians, coordinators and psychologists. The work is about earning their trust and turning it into referrals you can see in the numbers.

**Why this role**

* **Work that matters.** Every clinic that refers to us means more patients get the right support after surgery.
* **Commercial, without the hard sell.** You’re judged on relevance and credibility, not on pushing a product.
* **A strong start in the Netherlands.** FitForMe was founded here, so you open doors from a position of credibility.
* **Something to build in the UK.** Some of it is new, and you get to shape it.

* Follow up when a clinic starts referring patients and help it grow.
* Support a senior colleague on our most important Dutch account: logistics, quick responses and following up agreed actions.
* Keep the CRM accurate. Use referral data per clinic to decide *where* to spend your time, and treatment pathway insights to decide *how*.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------

Als Productmanager binnen ons ontwikkelteam ben jij de drijvende kracht achter onze productportfolio. Jouw taken reiken verder dan alleen het beheren van bestaande producten; je bent degene die vernieuwing omarmt en implementeert. Met een scherp oog voor Rijksbrede ontwikkelingen, werk je aan het verfijnen van methoden, processen en producten.
  
  
Jouw aanpak is niet enkel gebaseerd op intuïtie, maar stevig verankerd in het plan-do-check-act-principe. Het vertalen van interdepartementale standaarden en regelgeving naar onze productportfolio is jouw tweede natuur. Je bent de brug tussen verschillende disciplines, waarbij je het primair proces en de gehele keten niet uit het oog verliest. Jouw advies is niet slechts een suggestie, maar een fundament voor besluitvorming. Door actief draagvlak te creëren en gebruikerstafels te betrekken, beweeg je soepel door organisatorische krachtenvelden.
  
  
Als een ware kennisbron binnen ons team vergaar en deel je expertise op het gebied van facilitaire thema's. Jouw netwerk strekt zich uit binnen DJI, J&V en zelfs interdepartementaal. Het voeren van regie over complexe facilitaire projecten is voor jou een uitdaging die je met vastberadenheid aangaat. Je schroomt niet om interne of externe expertise in te schakelen om de kwaliteit binnen onze productportfolio's te verbeteren.
  
  
Analyseren, stroomlijnen en verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Processen, producten en diensten worden onder jouw leiding geoptimaliseerd, altijd in lijn met geldende wet- en regelgeving. Jouw verantwoordelijkheid strekt zich ook uit tot leveranciers- en contractmanagement, waarbij SLA's worden opgesteld en beheerd in nauwe samenwerking met het IUC.
  
  
Als Gedelegeerd Opdrachtgever neem jij het voortouw bij complexe Europese aanbestedingen. Samenwerking met verschillende bedrijfsvoering disciplines is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je bent de spil tussen behoeften van afnemers en de aanbestedingsprocessen, waarbij je diverse disciplines samenbrengt voor een gezamenlijk doel.
  
  
Als vertegenwoordiger van JenV / CDV in klantenraden van Rijksbreed categoriemanagement ben jij de stem van onze organisatie. Je brengt behoeften en eisen van onze klanten in, zodat we onze dienstverlening optimaal kunnen afstemmen.
  
  
Kortom, als lid van ons team ben jij niet slechts een producteigenaar, maar een essentiële schakel in het voortdurend verbeteren en innoveren van onze dienstverlening. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap tillen we onze producten naar nieuwe hoogten en blijven we een betrouwbare partner voor onze klanten en stakeholders.

Kijk jij voorbij aan wat iemand gedaan heeft?

**Gunstige arbeidsvoorwaarden**
-------------------------------

Bij DJI vinden we het belangrijk dat jij je werk goed kunt doen én met plezier naar je werk gaat. Daarom bieden we veel voordelen die je helpen in

**De divisie Flooring Systems biedt een breed en aantrekkelijk assortiment milieuvriendelijk linoleum, hoogwaardige vinylvloeren, schoonloopsystemen, tapijttegels, naaldvilt, en Flotex, de wasbare textielen vloerbedekking. Dankzij hun voortreffelijke technische eigenschappen en aantrekkelijke design zijn deze vloerbedekkingen de eerste keus voor openbare gebouwen, warenhuizen, ziekenhuizen en andere zorginstellingen, scholen, bibliotheken, kantoren, vrijetijdscentra, hotels, restaurants en cafés alsmede voor toepassingen in de woonmarkt.**  
**Met een marktaandeel van ruim 65% is Forbo wereldwijd marktleider in linoleum. Onder de merknaam Eurocol levert Flooring Systems ook kant-en-klare lijmen voor vloerinstallaties en keramische tegels en nivelleermassa's voor de bouwbranche**

**Stageopdracht Product Management**
------------------------------------

Stageopdracht: vergemakkelijken van de installatie van Marmoleum

  

**Korte samenvatting**

**Achtergrond**

**Murphy** deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: **voice AI for debt collection**. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with **Santander, Revolut, BBVA** and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to **secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry**.

#### **About the team**

Collections agents only work in production when someone owns the build in detail. Each one handles regulated conversations, sensitive customer situations and payment outcomes, and has to behave correctly every time.

Forward Deployed Engineers own that build. They turn a customer's collections strategy, policies and systems into a working agent, prove it in a POC, and take it to full production. They work with Account Executives during the sale, with Deployment Strategists after go-live, and with Product and Engineering to make the platform better with every deployment.

#### **About the role**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the technical execution of AI agent builds for our enterprise customers, mainly banks and large lenders. You scope with the customer's technical and operations leads, design the agent, build and test it, and launch it on their systems. After launch, you own the agent's performance: you analyze production data, explain results to the customer, and decide what to change in the agent and the contact strategy. Each deployment should leave behind patterns, tools and tests that make the next one faster.

**You'll be based in Amsterdam and lead enterprise deployments for banks and large lenders in the Netherlands.**

#### **In this role, you will**

* Own end-to-end delivery of enterprise agent builds, from POC scoping through implementation, evaluation and production launch.
* Define the agent operating procedures (actions, guardrails, escalations) with the customer, and turn them into agent behavior.
* Design and engineer the prompt and agent logic that drives identification, negotiation and payment conversations, across languages and channels.
* Configure Murphy to fit each client’s needs on how and when to reach debtors: call windows, retry and frequency rules within each country's regulations, channel mix (voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), payment links and hand-offs to human agents.
* Build evaluation and simulation harnesses, plus regression tests against real call outcomes, to catch errors and drift before customers do.
* Build, validate and maintain integrations with customer systems: core banking, collections platforms, data pipelines, telephony.
* Diagnose failures from transcripts, traces and logs, find the root cause, and fix it in the agent or flag it to Engineering.
